name: web-fashion-store-plp-pdp-and-mobile-flow-board
title: Fashion store listing, detail and mobile views laid over a blurred editorial portrait
whatItIs: A board with a large uppercase statement at top and four tall screens over a dark, blurred portrait: product detail with an inline outfit gallery and reviews, a mobile version, a hoodie listing grid with filters, and a mobile listing. Each ends in a black footer with an enormous cropped 'off-white' wordmark.
whatItMeans: Clean and dependable; white pages and vivid clothing photos keep the focus on products.
techniques: Use a neutral white shell with plain type so product colours lead.
Present listing, detail and mobile flows side by side.
End every page with a giant cropped wordmark on black.
Use colourful backdrops behind each model photo.
Place a large uppercase statement above the screens.

vocabulary.definition: An oversized brand name cut off at the page bottom.
A presentation showing several connected screens.
